# Bloxwap Font

> Free, open-source type system from Bloxwap, Inc. (SIL Open Font License 1.1): Bloxwap Sans, a rounded neo-grotesk with 9 weights, italics and tabular figures by default; Bloxwap Mono, the same design on a 600-unit cell with code ligatures; and Bloxwap Pixel, a pixel display face with weight and roundness (ROND) axes. Companion families add Arabic, Korean (KR) and Simplified Chinese (SC).

Use on the web: `<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://bloxwap.github.io/font/bloxwap-font.css">` then `font-family: "Bloxwap Sans"`, `"Bloxwap Mono"` or `"Bloxwap Pixel"`.

Download: [Bloxwap-Fonts.zip](https://github.com/bloxwap/font/releases/latest/download/Bloxwap-Fonts.zip) (all families and formats).

## Docs

- [Overview](https://bloxwap.github.io/font/docs/): the three families, companions and principles
- [Installation](https://bloxwap.github.io/font/docs/installation/): downloads, desktop install, @font-face self-hosting with static fallbacks, Next.js next/font/local, Tailwind CSS v4, CSS custom properties
- [Usage](https://bloxwap.github.io/font/docs/usage/): weights, italics, variable axes, OpenType features and localized forms in CSS
- [One family for every script](https://bloxwap.github.io/font/docs/multi-script/): the combined stylesheet that merges Arabic, Hangul and hanzi into one family name with unicode-range
- [Bloxwap Sans](https://bloxwap.github.io/font/docs/families/sans/)
- [Bloxwap Mono](https://bloxwap.github.io/font/docs/families/mono/): code ligatures, box drawing
- [Bloxwap Pixel](https://bloxwap.github.io/font/docs/families/pixel/): wght and ROND axes
- [Sans Arabic](https://bloxwap.github.io/font/docs/families/sans-arabic/): Bloxwap Sans Arabic and Mono Arabic
- [Sans KR](https://bloxwap.github.io/font/docs/families/sans-kr/): Bloxwap Sans KR and Mono KR (Hangul)
- [Sans SC](https://bloxwap.github.io/font/docs/families/sans-sc/): Bloxwap Sans SC and Mono SC (Simplified Chinese)
- [OpenType features](https://bloxwap.github.io/font/docs/opentype-features/): every feature in each font
- [Variable fonts and axes](https://bloxwap.github.io/font/docs/variable-fonts/)
- [Language support](https://bloxwap.github.io/font/docs/language-support/): Hyperglot language lists and script coverage
- [Character set](https://bloxwap.github.io/font/docs/character-set/): glyph counts and a glyph browser
- [Design](https://bloxwap.github.io/font/docs/design/): skeleton stroking, metrics, style rules, clean-room policy
- [Building from source](https://bloxwap.github.io/font/docs/building/): the font build pipeline and this website
- [License](https://bloxwap.github.io/font/docs/license/): SIL Open Font License 1.1
- [Changelog](https://bloxwap.github.io/font/docs/changelog/)

## Data

- [Family index](https://bloxwap.github.io/font/data/index.json): every family, whether it is built, counts and coverage
- Per family: `https://bloxwap.github.io/font/data/<id>.json` (axes, instances, features, languages, coverage) and `https://bloxwap.github.io/font/data/<id>.glyphs.json` (glyph list); ids: sans, mono, pixel, sans-arabic, mono-arabic, sans-kr, mono-kr, sans-sc, mono-sc
